SLB Vejle Medicinsk Afdeling is a medical department in Denmark that participates in the national quality monitoring for inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) through the Danish IBD Database (DANIBD). The department is evaluated against national clinical quality indicators, and its performance data is published in DANIBD's annual reports.

In the 2023 DANIBD annual report, SLB Vejle Medicinsk Afdeling was highlighted for having one of the lowest target achievement rates for Indicator 4, which measured systematic follow-up with fecal calprotectin during biologic and immunosuppressive treatment [^src1]. The department achieved a 56% fulfillment rate for this indicator, placing it among the bottom three departments nationally alongside Rigshospitalet and Nordsjælland [^src1]. The department also contributed data for Indicator 6 (re-operation within 30 days of primary surgery), reporting zero re-operations [^src1], and Indicator 7 (colonoscopy for patients with primary sclerosing cholangitis), where it achieved an 80% fulfillment rate (4 out of 5 patients) [^src1].

In the 2024 DANIBD report, the department's performance was tracked across updated indicators. For Indicator 4, which shifted to focus on [[dexa-scanning|DEXA-scanning]] during steroid treatment, the department reported a 31% fulfillment rate (18 out of 58 eligible patients) [^src3]. For Indicator 5, which measured [[calprotectin|calprotectin]] testing, the department achieved an 80% fulfillment rate, evaluating 551 out of 690 patients [^src3]. Additionally, the department was included in broader patient population and diagnostic distribution metrics, recording a 76% rate (71 out of 94) in one of the demographic or clinical contact categories [^src2].
